question: 各地区不同退款原因的退款金额分布
gold_sql: select r.region_name, re.reason, sum(distinct re.refund_amount) from refunds re left join orders o on re.order_id = o.order_id left join users u on o.user_id = u.user_id left join regions r on u.region_id = r.region_id group by 1,2
raw_output:
SELECT r.region_name, ref.reason, SUM(ref.refund_amount) AS total_refund_amount
FROM refunds ref
JOIN orders o ON ref.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN regions r ON u.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE ref.status = '已退款'
GROUP BY r.region_name, ref.reason
